documents.title: CCSS — Base Mínima Contributiva (decreto)
documents.notes: Annual churn — verify vigente version each re-crawl; figures only from primary decree. CARRIES NO RATES (#114): the escala contributiva table is a raster image in the SINALEVI payload (image005.png), not markup, so HTML→text extraction cannot recover it — the ingested text jumps from «Establecer la siguiente escala contributiva» to «Notas:». Same for the sibling ficha 82804. The doc is kept for Acuerdos Segundo–Cuarto (how the BMC is adjusted when the minimum wage moves); never cite it for a percentage or a BMC amount — those live in ccss-escala-salud, ccss-escala-ivm and salarios-minimos, ingested from the CCSS actas that transcribe the same tables as text.

documents.title: CCSS — Escala contributiva de trabajadores independientes y asegurados voluntarios, Seguro de IVM
documents.norma: Ficha técnica PE-DAE-1179-2025 (acuerdo Junta Directiva, artículo 4°, sesión 9570)
documents.notes: Carries the IVM rates by income bracket (afiliado 4.16–8.42%, conjunta 9.91% + 1.75% Estado como tal = 11.66% global). Brackets are in SM multiples, so they stay correct across wage decrees — resolve colón amounts via salarios-minimos. Adopted verbatim by the Junta Directiva on 2025-12-18 (9 votos en firme) per artículo 33 and Transitorio XI del Reglamento del Seguro de IVM; rige hasta 2028-12-31, next escalón 2029 — re-crawl then. Ingested from the sesión's anexos zip because SINALEVI publishes CCSS escala acuerdos as raster images (#114).

documents.title: CCSS — Escala contributiva de trabajadores independientes y asegurados voluntarios, Seguro de Salud
documents.notes: Salud rates by income bracket (afiliado 2.89–10.69%, conjunta 12.00% + 0.25% Estado como tal), still vigente — the 2026 adjustment touched IVM only (see ccss-escala-ivm). Same acuerdo SINALEVI carries as an image in ccss-bmc; the acta transcribes the table as text. Page-ranged because the full acta is 170 pages of unrelated Junta Directiva business — re-verify the range if CCSS re-publishes the acta.

documents.title: Fijación de salarios mínimos para el sector privado (vigente 2026)
documents.notes: La Gaceta 229, Alcance 156. Supplies the SM the CCSS escalas are denominated in — Trabajadores en Ocupación No Calificada ¢373.092,30/mes, from which the vigente base mínima contributiva follows: 0.87 SM = ¢324.590 (IVM) and 0.9295 SM = ¢346.789 (SEM), both matching CCSS's published BMC. Annual churn — re-fetch each wage decree; the alcance number and page range change every year.

documents.title: Reglamento del Régimen de Tributación Simplificada
documents.notes: Key fact: artículo 1 is a closed list of eligible activities (software and professional services absent) and artículo 2 bars entry to anyone with activities outside it — artículo 3 carries the thresholds. Vigente text consolidates reform 45209-H; re-verify the activity list each re-crawl. Rationale, provenance and the replaced `rts-requisitos` flyer: docs/research/corpus-viability.md §1 and issue #108.

documents.title: Operaciones exentas relacionadas con las exportaciones (artículo 11 del Reglamento del IVA)
documents.notes: Primary DGT resolution behind the EY/observador summaries; consolidates and derogates DGT-R-035-2019, DGT-R-038-2019, DGT-R-036-2021. Quotes LIVA art. 8.1: services are exempt only when used outside the territorial scope — consumption entirely outside CR, not merely billing abroad.
